create_output_projection: create an OutputProjection module to project node, edge, and global readout features through linear layers and normalization
build_output_layer_vector: build an OutputLayer module configured for Vector output to predict 3D force predictions from backbone features
build_output_layer_scalar: build an OutputLayer module configured for Scalar output to predict energy values from backbone features
run_output_projection_forward: run the OutputProjection forward pass to project and normalize concatenated node, edge, and global readout features
review_output_layer_forward: review the OutputLayer forward method that applies an MLP then a final linear layer to produce predictions
